sources.title: Solar Pro 2: model specifications and versions
sources.evidence: Names Solar Pro 2, gives 31B parameters and 65,536-token context, and marks chat, reasoning and tool calling supported. Lists English, Korean and Japanese. The rolling solar-pro2 alias points to solar-pro2-251215; versions include the July 10, 2025 release. Announces October 30, 2026 service retirement.

sources.title: Solar Pro 2 Preview: Small. Powerful. Now with reasoning.
sources.evidence: Dated May 20, 2025 and explicitly says Solar Pro 2 Preview is available on Upstage Console. Describes 31B parameters, 64K context and selectable chat/reasoning modes, with a full release still forthcoming.

sources.title: Solar Pro 2: Fluent. Reasoning. Frontier.
sources.evidence: July 10, 2025 general-release announcement identifies Upstage, repeats 31B, and documents multilingual language generation, reasoning and tool use. Provides API access and describes commercial cloud/on-premises deployment.

sources.title: Solar Pro 2 Breaks Into Global Frontier AI
sources.evidence: July 21, 2025 announcement explicitly calls Solar Pro 2 Upstage’s proprietary LLM and repeats its 31-billion-parameter size.

sources.title: Compare models
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27: exact Solar Pro 2 column gives 31B in the Parameters row. Solar Mini 4 is separately 35B / 3B active. No active value is provided for Solar Pro 2.

sources.title: Solar Open Technical Report
sources.evidence: Reopened original January 2026 report: Sections 3.1, 4 and 5 identify Solar Pro 2 as a synthetic-data source and fine-tuned query generator. Table 2 gives 102.6B total/12B active for Solar Open, a separately trained MoE; no unchanged-base relationship or Solar Pro 2 active count is established.

sources.title: Solar Pro2 Prompting Handbook (English)
sources.evidence: Official notebook uses the exact solar-pro2 identifier in chat-completion examples with text messages and textual responses. Explains low/high reasoning_effort; its use of hybrid describes selectable reasoning modes, not a disclosed network architecture.

sources.title: Solar Pro 2 final-launch language benchmark table
sources.evidence: Original image embedded in the July 10, 2025 final release post, downloaded and visually inspected October 27. Model Size is explicitly 30.9B for both Solar Pro 2 and Solar Pro 2 [R, Reasoning]. The final-launch frontier benchmark image independently repeats both 30.9B values. These are more precise nominal totals than the prose/current docs rounded 31B; neither table separately labels an active count for Solar Pro 2.

sources.title: Solar Pro 2 final-launch frontier benchmark table
sources.evidence: Visually inspected original final-launch table: Solar Pro 2 chat and reasoning each have Model Size 30.9B. MoE competitors separately display total-A-active notation, while Solar Pro 2 has only the model-size value. This supports nominal total precision, not an inferred active count.

sources.title: Solar Pro 3: 2× Agentic Performance — What Changed
sources.evidence: March 24, 2026 original comparison identifies solar-pro2-251215 and solar-pro3-260323. Its 102B total/12B active statement explicitly describes Solar Pro 3. Same API interface, throughput and serving behavior as Pro 2 is not unchanged model architecture or parameter-count lineage.

sources.title: Solar Open 2 Technical Report, version 2
sources.evidence: July 24, 2026 original report describes 250B/15B-active Solar Open 2 and partial 5.69B weight transfer from Solar Open 1 with structural changes. Section 5.1 and Table 3 explicitly compare total/activated sizes for named models, but do not include Solar Pro 2 or disclose its active count. These successor-model counts cannot transfer to Pro 2.

sources.title: Frontier AI Vulnerability Benchmark in 2025
sources.evidence: Original empirical benchmark Table 1 identifies Upstage Solar Pro 2 (South Korea) at 31B under Size. Section 3.2 calls these reported parameter sizes. The table has no active column and mixes, for example, Maverick 17B with Qwen3-Next 80B; it cannot establish a consistent active-count convention for Solar Pro 2.

developer.note: The developer identifies the model as its own.

family.note: Retains the catalog’s normalized Solar Pro family label; the preview names Solar Pro as its predecessor.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit public availability is the May 20 preview. July 10 is the later general release, not first availability.

open_weights.note: Proprietary model offered through API and commercial deployment; these sources do not describe a public weight release.

license.note: Supported descriptive classification from Upstage’s explicit proprietary designation, not an invented named license.

parameters_b.note: Nominal developer-published total, preserving the 30.9B precision in both final-launch benchmark tables. Upstage rounds this to 31B in prose and current model specifications; this is not an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh original-source and later-comparison review found no separately reported active count for Solar Pro 2. Its 30.9B model-size row is not an active column. Solar Mini 4, Pro 3 and Solar Open counts describe other models; API compatibility and synthetic-data generation do not establish unchanged-model lineage.

architecture.note: No exact-model dense/MoE/hybrid network specification found after checking official launch material, model documentation, later research and architecture/training searches. Hybrid in the handbook means selectable chat/reasoning modes; Solar Open’s MoE design cannot be transferred here.

context_window.note: Exact documented context length; the preview’s rounded 64K statement is consistent.

modalities.note: Exact-model official examples use text prompts and textual completions. No image/audio capability is added from separate document-processing products.

reasoning.note: Selectable reasoning mode is explicitly documented.

tool_call.note: The exact model specifications mark tool calling supported.

description.value: Upstage text model with chat and reasoning modes, tool calling, and support for English, Korean, and Japanese.
description.note: Replaces the broad flagship/production-workflow wording with documented features.

patch.notes: 30.9B is Upstage’s nominal total in both final-launch benchmark tables, rounded to 31B in its model documentation; active parameters and neural architecture are not separately disclosed. The release date is the May 20, 2025 public preview; general availability followed on July 10. The rolling solar-pro2 alias currently maps to solar-pro2-251215. Upstage documents retirement on October 30, 2026; specifications do not establish current endpoint operation.

summary: Fresh parameter review refines the nominal total from rounded 31B to the developer’s 30.9B in both final-launch benchmark tables. Active parameters remain undisclosed after original launch-table, current-documentation and later-research checks. Preserves the other twelve field assessments, including 65,536 context, text input/output, reasoning, tool calling and the May 20, 2025 public-preview date.

parameter_reaudit.outcome: Nominal total refined to 30.9B from two original final-launch tables; active count remains undisclosed.

reopened_originals.result: Independently read current model specs, preview, final launch, frontier announcement and current comparison. They retain rounded 31B; current 3B-active page navigation belongs to Solar Mini 4, and future 100B+ announcement is a different model.

searches: "Solar Pro 2" "active" parameters; "Solar Pro 2" "31B" parameters architecture; "Solar Pro 2" "activated" parameters.
Exact model plus "active parameters", "Active Params", "activated parameters" and Korean "활성" "파라미터".
Original later research searches using exact model and parameters on arxiv.org/aclanthology.org, plus developer-restricted upstage.ai searches.
Reopened Solar Open report 2601.07022v1, Solar Open 2 report 2607.20062v2 Table 3, March 2026 Pro 3 comparison and Vulcan original benchmark Table 1.
parameter_reaudit.visual_review: Preview table Size(B) is 30.9. More importantly, both final-launch tables label both Solar Pro 2 modes 30.9B in Model Size, justifying precision without assuming preview/final identity. None labels Pro 2 active parameters.
rejected_leads: Secondary Model Beats lists 31B active/dense without original counting evidence found; not accepted as a developer or original research convention.
A secondary AI Stats result assigns Pro 3-like 102B/12B to a Pro 2 dated record; current Upstage originals contradict that total.
ICT R&D Week slide URL returned a 404 HTML page with HTTP 200, so its search snippet was not treated as freshly accessed slide evidence.
parameter_reaudit.limitations: The active count remains unresolved after the bounded fresh review. No weights downloaded; model size is published nominal precision, not an exact learned-tensor count.
